# T-2: Relocate cleanup log dirs

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Ensure finalize-cleanup logger and runtime log paths survive deletion of the active worktree when the requested agent work dir is inside that worktree.

## Acceptance Criteria
- relative `--agent-work-dir .sdd-forge/agent-work` from a deleted worktree is relocated under the main repository.
- relative `--log-file` and relative `config.logs.dir` values under the deleted worktree are relocated under the main repository.
- absolute `--agent-work-dir`, `--log-file`, and `config.logs.dir` values outside the worktree are honored.
- cleanup stderr has no deleted-worktree ENOENT log warning after worktree removal.

## Implementation Notes
Resolve durable log-related paths before `initContainer()` when possible so `paths.agentWorkDir` and `paths.logDir` are durable. Keep dispatcher `--log-file` resolution consistent with the same inside-worktree relocation rule. Limit relocation to `flow run finalize-cleanup`.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local worktree fixture runs cleanup with worktree-local agent work dir, log-file, and logs.dir variants and asserts the worktree is removed while stderr lacks `[sdd-forge] log write failed` and deleted-path ENOENT.
